instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potato; place in a medium saucepan along with salt. Cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g sweet potato
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid in the saucepan is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until sweet potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.

When the sweet potatoes are tender, drain in a colander and transfer to a medium bowl. Add butter, maple syrup, and cinnamon, then using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Set aside to cool completely, about 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
½ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potato mash is cool, add both flours and baking powder to the bowl. Stir until the dough starts to come together.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup oat flour
1 cup all-purpose flour
½ tsp baking powder

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the dough to a clean countertop and knead with your hands until you can form it into a ball, 1-2 minutes. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 30 minutes.
When the dough is firm, preheat oven to 350°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper.

Dust the counter with a small amount of flour, then roll out the dough to about ¼-inch thickness. Use a cookie cutter or knife to cut crackers into desired shapes (about 1 1/2 inches in diameter), then arrange on the baking sheets, spacing them a ½-inch apart.
Place crackers in the preheated oven and bake until starting to turn golden, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, 30 minutes.
